jobs.prompt: Create a production mother artboard for the Angus world exploration screen, a 16:9 desktop game UI for choosing global reporting regions. Use the user-approved reference image as the main style reference for brighter ivory paper, premium editorial paper objects, and a faceted low-poly paper world map. Keep Angus identity: deep navy #0F1A2E editorial engineering board, vivid red-orange #E84B2C anomaly/deadline marks, restrained cyan tracking/signal marks, warm paper #F5EDD8, modern supernatural weekly magazine mood, cool confident urgent black humor. Composition: large central world map board as the main object, recognizable world silhouette built from abstract faceted polygon paper shapes with subtle paper grain and clean printed edges; left stacked region index paper folder with blank card slots; right selected-region dossier folder with blank story preview slot, blank title/body paper zones, and a bottom CTA area; bottom channel ticker strip. Materials: clean printed matter, crisp paper edges, crop marks, binder clips, paper tabs, subtle halftone dots, restrained red-cyan misregistration, deliberate 2-4px pixel block clusters. Leave large low-noise blank safe areas for Godot-rendered dynamic text, numbers, region names, lock reasons, and button labels. Do not include readable text, Chinese characters, real numbers, real region names, countdowns, fake task states, fake pins, fake clickable buttons, labels, watermark, or signature. This is a style and component-derivation mother artboard, not a final interactive screenshot.

jobs.prompt: Create a revised production mother artboard for the Angus world exploration screen, a 16:9 desktop game UI. Preserve the successful bright-paper Angus v6 direction, but correct the layout for real Godot text overlays. Critical correction 1: make the entire right selected-region dossier/front sheet orthographic and axis-aligned. Its visible main paper face must be perfectly vertical/horizontal relative to the canvas, with parallel screen edges, no tilt, no trapezoid perspective, and no slanted writing area. Backing papers and side tabs may create depth behind it, but every visible text-bearing slot on the front sheet must be a clean level rectangle. Critical correction 2: fix the left region index stack. The bottom visible card must have its lower-left corner and full writing rectangle unobstructed. Remove or lower the dark navy triangular pocket so it never covers the bottom card's content safe area. If a pocket/flap remains, it must sit behind or below the card stack as decoration only, not over any blank card interior. Leave a clear visible paper margin around every card interior. Central map correction: make the world map cool blue-gray low-poly paper, closer to the user's favored reference: faceted polygon continents with paper texture, premium abstract cartographic feel, not white carved paper. Composition: central world map board as the main visual object; left stacked region index folder with 4 horizontal blank card slots; right selected-region dossier folder with a top preview slot, a large body note area, and a bottom CTA label area; bottom channel ticker strip with horizontal content slots. All dynamic text-safe zones must be horizontal, front-facing, axis-aligned, low-noise, and free of decorative intrusions. Do not include readable text, Chinese characters, real numbers, real region names, countdowns, fake task states, fake map pins, fake clickable labels, watermark, or signature.

jobs.prompt: Create a stricter revised production mother artboard for the Angus world exploration screen, a 16:9 desktop game UI. Preserve the v6c strengths: clean bright ivory paper UI objects, cool blue-gray low-poly paper world map, deep navy editorial engineering board, vivid red-orange anomaly/deadline accents, restrained cyan signal accents, premium modern supernatural weekly magazine mood, crisp print edges, binder clips, folder tabs, halftone dots, subtle red-cyan print misregistration, and deliberate 2-4px pixel block clusters. The front sheet outer border and every inner content rectangle must be parallel to the canvas edges, with no tilt, trapezoid, or perspective skew. Backing papers and side tabs may sit behind it for depth, but they must not make the front sheet look slanted. Hard correction B: remove the dark navy triangular pocket/flap from the left index stack content area. The bottom index card must be completely visible, including its lower-left corner, outer border, red side tab, and full blank writing rectangle. No diagonal pocket, flap, clip, binder, tab, stripe, or decorative element may cover any part of any card's blank interior or readable margin. If a left-side binder cover exists, keep it clearly behind the cards and below their content safe areas. Hard correction C: every text-safe zone must be a clean horizontal rectangle with at least 32 px visual margin away from tabs, ribbons, corner marks, dots, borders, clips, screws, arrow plates, colored blocks, and halftone clusters. Composition: central world map board as main visual object; left stacked region index folder with exactly 4 fully visible horizontal blank card slots; right selected-region dossier folder with top preview slot, large body note area, and bottom CTA label area; bottom channel ticker strip with horizontal content slots. The UI must look like layered editorial paper objects, but dynamic-text-bearing surfaces must behave like stable Godot layout rectangles. Do not include readable text, Chinese characters, real numbers, real region names, countdowns, fake task states, fake map pins, fake clickable labels, watermark, or signature.

Do not reduce the blue channel or push paper into yellow, ochre, sepia, tea stain, parchment, old archive, old newspaper, beige/brown, or dirty paper.
